title: SanDisk Nintendo Switch 128 GB microSD vs SanDisk Extreme 128 GB

brand.product: SanDisk microSDXC für Nintendo Switch 128 GB, UHS-I U3 V30 (SDSQXAO-128G-GNCZN)

alternative.product: SanDisk Extreme microSDXC 128 GB, UHS-I U3 V30 A2 (SDSQXAA-128G-GN6MA)

summary: SanDisk's licensed Nintendo Switch card and its own Extreme card are both 128 GB microSDXC cards rated U3 and V30, and the Extreme costs less while listing a faster read speed.
evidence: alternate.de product pages read on 13 Nov 2026 and read again with a second fetch, including VAT, both available now: SanDisk Nintendo Switch 128 GB (EAN 0619659171520, maker no. SDSQXAO-128G-GNCZN) at 48.59 euros and SanDisk Extreme 128 GB (EAN 0619659188450, maker no. SDSQXAA-128G-GN6MA) at 35.89 euros. Both list microSDXC, UHS-I, U3 and V30. The Nintendo card lists read up to 100 MB/s and write up to 90 MB/s; the Extreme lists read up to 160 MB/s, write up to 90 MB/s and A2. Both barcodes start with SanDisk's company prefix 0619659. The SD Association sets out what U3, V30 and A2 mean.
differences: The Nintendo card carries Nintendo's licence and red Switch artwork; the Extreme doesn't. Any microSDXC card works in a Switch, and Nintendo's own support page asks for microSDXC with UHS-I and a fast read speed, which both meet. The Extreme includes an SD adapter; the Nintendo page doesn't say. The Extreme page's description gives up to 190 MB/s read while its spec table says 160 MB/s; we use the table. Neither has enough shopper ratings to count.
why: Both cards come from SanDisk with the same U3 and V30 ratings, and the cheaper one lists the faster read speed. The Nintendo licence adds artwork, not speed.

title: Kingston Canvas Go! Plus 128 GB microSD vs SanDisk Extreme 128 GB

brand.product: Kingston Canvas Go! Plus microSDXC 128 GB, UHS-I U3 V30 A2 (SDCG4/128GB)

alternative.product: SanDisk Extreme microSDXC 128 GB, UHS-I U3 V30 A2 (SDSQXAA-128G-GN6MA)

summary: Both are 128 GB microSDXC cards rated U3, V30 and A2 with an SD adapter, and the SanDisk Extreme costs less at the same shop.
evidence: alternate.de product pages read on 13 Nov 2026 and read again with a second fetch, including VAT, both available now: Kingston Canvas Go! Plus 128 GB (EAN 0740617347944, maker no. SDCG4/128GB) at 51.90 euros and SanDisk Extreme 128 GB (EAN 0619659188450, maker no. SDSQXAA-128G-GN6MA) at 35.89 euros. Both list microSDXC, UHS-I, Class 10, U3, V30 and A2, and both include an SD adapter. The SD Association sets out the minimum speeds these ratings promise.
differences: Kingston lists a faster top read speed (up to 200 MB/s against 160 MB/s) and no write speed; SanDisk lists write up to 90 MB/s. The ratings both carry promise the same minimums, so the difference is only in peak speed, which matters when copying lots of files to a computer. Neither has enough shopper ratings to count, and no test we read covers these two.
why: The ratings that matter for cameras, phones and consoles are the same, and the cheaper card is from the market leader.

title: Diamant Feinster Zucker vs Jeden Tag Zucker Raffinade
summary: Both are 1 kg bags of fine white crystal sugar with the same nutrition table, and the own-label bag costs about half as much.
evidence: Both read on mytime.de on 13 Nov 2026 and read again with a second fetch, including VAT: Diamant Feinster Zucker 1 kg (EAN 4008381145002) at 2.29 euros and Jeden Tag Zucker Raffinade 1 kg (EAN 4306188050971) at 1.19 euros. Both pages describe the sugar as fine crystal sugar (feiner Kristallzucker) and give the same values per 100 g: 1700 kJ / 400 kcal, 100 g carbohydrate, all of it sugars, and no fat, protein or salt.
differences: Neither page prints an ingredient list or names the maker, which EU rules don't require for a one-ingredient food. The Jeden Tag bag is labelled Raffinade, the top refining grade; Diamant's page doesn't state a grade, so we can't say both are the same grade. myTime delivers free only from 70 euros, so this saving matters inside a bigger shop.
why: White sugar is one ingredient, and the two labels give the same crystal size and the same nutrition table.
